segments.title: 第76章 年輪發布
segments.content:
Rekindling Your Youth Chapter 76: Release of "Annual Ring"

In the evening, as Xu Youyu had requested last night, Li Luo came to find the Literature Club's dedicated classroom.

He knocked on the door and glanced inside.

Besides Xu Youyu, familiar faces like Hua Xiuxiu were also there as new members, getting to know the club.

"You're Li Luo, right?" Hearing Xu Youyu's reminder, Duan Qintian in the classroom turned his head toward the door and waved at Li Luo. "Come over here and fill out a form."

"Oh, okay." Li Luo walked over, took a club application form, and briefly filled it out.

Duan Qintian was not at all surprised by Li Luo's final decision to join the Literature Club. After all, it was Xu Youyu who had made the move.

Nearby, Qin Yawei caught sight of Li Luo and immediately snorted coldly, chuckling, "I wonder who it was last night that refused so decisively, only to come running back today?"

Li Luo glanced at the petty vice president, unconcerned. He simply smiled and said, "Perhaps Sister Xu's method of invitation is more persuasive."

Hearing this, Xu Youyu rolled her eyes, thinking to herself, *So taking on a month of cleaning duty is that persuasive, huh?*

But to Qin Yawei, Li Luo's words held an entirely different meaning.

*Isn't it just because Xu Youyu is good-looking?*

At this thought, Qin Yawei looked down on Li Luo even more.

Another vulgar man!

"These two days are still the club recruitment period. This Saturday at noon, we'll have a simple welcome meeting," Duan Qintian said. "Remember to come and attend."

"Okay."

Li Luo was just going through the motions. After filling out the application, he said his goodbyes and left.

Xu Youyu also used the excuse of Student Council business to walk out of the classroom with him. As they went downstairs, she teased, "You've been marked by Qin Yawei now."

"Huh? Marked for what?"

"As a stinky man seduced by beauty, probably." Xu Youyu stretched, her school uniform outlining a startling curve. "And to think I even agreed to a month of cleaning."

"Looking at it now, a month doesn't seem to be enough," Li Luo said with a click of his tongue. "Factoring in the compensation for the mental distress I've suffered from that vice president, I think you should add another month."

"Get lost!" Xu Youyu shot him a glare, then said, "I'm heading to the Student Council first. Remember to go home together tonight. You and Xixi wait for me."

"Oh, got it." Li Luo nodded. "Go on, busy bee."

"Heh." Xu Youyu turned to walk toward the Student Council building, but didn't forget to turn her head back and smile. "There's a regular Student Council meeting next week. Your first-year class presidents will have to attend too, which counts as formally joining the Student Council. You'll be a busy bee then too."

"You're overthinking it." Li Luo waved his hand and slowly walked away. "I might not even be the class president next week."

During the evening self-study session, Li Luo focused on his homework.

Since classes had officially started yesterday, the students of No. 1 Affiliated High School had settled into a normal academic rhythm.

In the first week of the first year of high school, most subjects were still in their early, introductory stages, without much difficult content.

After easily finishing his homework, Li Luo still had extra time to preview upcoming material.

He flipped through the textbooks for a few subjects, then copied them using his memory palace.

Li Luo had specifically opened up a room in his memory palace to store content related to his high school knowledge, which he then categorized by subject.

Having been reborn, he not only wanted to enjoy life but also planned to study hard this time.

With the help of his memory palace, and with two academic titans, Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu, at home to consult, Li Luo truly couldn't find any reason for himself to become a poor student.

He just didn't know how Yan Zhusheng's grades were.

After finishing his homework, Li Luo was reading a textbook when this question came to mind. He couldn't help but turn his head to glance at Yan Zhusheng, suddenly curious.

He looked at Yan Zhusheng's desk. Since there wasn't much homework, she had also finished and had secretly put on her earphones to listen to music.

Seeing Li Luo turn to look at her, Yan Zhusheng thought he wanted to listen to music too. She proactively took off one earphone and offered it to him.

Li Luo quickly waved his hands. After a thought, he took out a scratchpad and wrote something on it.

Li Luo: What was your high school entrance exam score?

Yan Zhusheng glanced at the scratchpad Li Luo passed over, then picked up her pen and wrote a reply.

Yan Zhusheng: 547

Oh?

Seeing this score, Li Luo raised his eyebrows, thinking that at least she wasn't an academic superstar on Ying Chanxi's level.

It made sense. If Yan Zhusheng were truly that formidable, she wouldn't have ended up in a parallel class.

Li Luo: Do you have any subjects you're good at?

Yan Zhusheng: English

Li Luo: How good?

Yan Zhusheng: Does a perfect score in English on the entrance exam count?

Li Luo: That strong?!

Yan Zhusheng: I spent a few years abroad with my mom when I was little.

During the second period, the two of them chatted casually like this, using the scratchpad.

They didn't chat continuously.

It was more that whenever one of them thought of something, they would write a couple of lines on the scratchpad between their desks, and the other would reply.

The rest of the time, Li Luo was seriously reading, while Yan Zhusheng was seriously listening to music. From time to time, she would close her eyes and nod her head to the beat. Her expression was aloof, yet her actions were a little cute.

Through this back and forth, Li Luo gained a general understanding of Yan Zhusheng's situation.

She was similar to Ying Chanxi, both from single-parent families. Except in Yan Zhusheng's case, her father had passed away early, and she was raised by her mother.

But now, due to her mother's work, her mom usually lived in the city center of Yuhang City.

Yan Zhusheng chose to board at the school, partly because of her own interests, and partly because her mother had moved to the city center.

Just as the two were chatting happily, the bell signaling the end of the evening self-study session rang.

Li Luo packed his schoolbag and waited at his seat for a moment before Ying Chanxi, who had come downstairs to find him, arrived to go home together.

The two went downstairs together and waited for a moment at the intersection of Houde Road. They then met up with a rushing Xu Youyu and walked home together.

"Fried noodles, fried noodles," Xu Youyu happily chanted on the way home.

"You two have a late-night snack every day. Aren't you afraid of getting fat?"

"I've always been under a hundred jin, okay?" Xu Youyu shot him a glare. "The food in the school cafeteria isn't good, so I usually eat very little."

"Under a hundred jin?" Li Luo was a bit surprised. He subconsciously glanced past Ying Chanxi in the middle and looked at Xu Youyu's chest, then was filled with solemn respect.

If teenage girls managed their diet properly, it was indeed easy for them to stay slim.

After all, they were young, and their metabolism was fast.

Ying Chanxi, for instance, had always been around ninety jin.

Li Luo himself was only around 120 or 130 jin, a standard build, so he wasn't afraid of gaining weight from eating.

"What are you looking at?" Ying Chanxi stared at his eyes, gnashing her teeth as she glared at him in a low voice.

"What's wrong?" Xu Youyu on the other side asked curiously.

Li Luo quickly shook his head. "Nothing, nothing."

Back home, Li Luo made fried noodles as usual. After eating his fill, he returned to his bedroom, leaving the dishwashing to the two girls.

He came to his computer, rubbed his hands together, an expression of anticipation on his face.

On one hand, Yan Zhusheng had already uploaded the audio file for "Annual Ring" to his email, and he could release it on major platforms today.

On the other hand, it was September 3rd, the day Qidian announced its monthly author earnings.

Li Luo sat down at his computer, opened the author backend, and expertly clicked on the earnings column.

A number was displayed brightly on it.

A full seven thousand-plus kuai!

Li Luo clenched his fist in satisfaction, shouting "Nice!" in his heart.

Currently, the average subscriptions had skyrocketed from the initial 2,000 to around 2,500. His earnings had reached a sum of seven thousand due to frequent updates and rapid growth in performance.

After all, writing after coming home from school every evening, he could at most write three or four thousand words; he couldn't continue to burn through his stockpile of chapters.

So, if the growth in average subscriptions slowed down later, Li Luo's monthly earnings would probably be around seven or eight thousand.

But for him right now, this was more than enough!

Li Luo was in a cheerful mood, already thinking about how to explain the situation to his mom.

If this money was used to pay the monthly mortgage, it could also greatly alleviate his parents' current pressure and prevent them from working too hard.

Of course, the 3rd was only when the earnings were announced. The money wouldn't actually be deposited into his bank account until around the 12th.

So Li Luo wasn't in a hurry. He planned to wait until the National Day holiday, when his September earnings would also be out. This would prove the sustainability of his income, and with his August earnings in hand, he would then explain everything clearly to his parents.

With that in mind, Li Luo opened various music platforms and websites like Weibo and Bilibili. He spent some time uploading the song "Annual Ring".

At the same time, at the end of the latest chapter of "I'm Really Not a Star" he had published tonight, he added a message.

Author's Note: Dear readers, the song "Annual Ring," which appeared earlier in the story, has been uploaded to all major music websites, thanks to a friend. If you're interested, you can go and have a listen.

(End of this chapter)
